transcript: I don't know where I am exactly. Somewhere near downtown. My wife is not breathing. Please hurry.
notes: Edge case: vague location + extreme severity. Location penalty should not override life-threat indicators. Expect P0 despite location score hit.

transcript: I need an ambulance at 2210 West Ridgeway Boulevard, apartment 4B. My foot hurts and I think I may have twisted my ankle walking down the stairs.
notes: Edge case: complete, precise address + low severity. High location score should not inflate priority. Expect P3.

transcript: Ha ha relax it's just a prank dude, we were filming a YouTube video. Nobody is actually hurt, we just wanted to see how fast you guys respond.
notes: Edge case: explicit prank indicators. POSSIBLE_PRANK penalty (-0.40) should suppress tier to P4.

transcript: There's been a car accident at the intersection of Route 9 and Crestwood Drive. Two cars are involved. One driver is bleeding from the head and not responding to me. The other driver seems okay.
notes: Edge case: contradictory input — one victim critical, one okay. System should key on the life-threat signal. Expect P0.

transcript: Mi esposo no está respirando. Estoy en la Calle Pino 789. Por favor, vengan rápido, creo que tuvo un ataque al corazón.
notes: Edge case: Spanish-language transcript. Parser must detect language, apply Spanish keyword set, and correctly identify not_breathing + cardiac indicators. Expect P0.

transcript: There's a fire truck that caught on fire down the street. At least four or five firefighters are involved and I can see people on the ground not moving. This is at 88 Industrial Parkway.
notes: Edge case: multiple victims (4-5 people), victim count multiplier should fire. Expect P0 with VICTIM_COUNT_MULTIPLIER in reason codes.

transcript: Um, I'm not sure if this is even a real emergency. My elderly neighbor hasn't picked up his mail in three days and I haven't seen him. He lives alone at 14 Cedar Court.
notes: Edge case: welfare check with unclear emergency. Low confidence parse, no life-threat indicators, complete address. Expect P3.

transcript: PLEASE HELP HE IS NOT BREATHING HE IS NOT BREATHING PLEASE COME NOW. We're at the McDonald's on Highway 17. PLEASE.
notes: Edge case: non-native or highly stressed phrasing — all caps, extreme repetition, fragmented urgency. Caller stress detection should flag HIGH. Expect P0 with CALLER_HIGH_DISTRESS in reason codes.

transcript: Someone dropped from a drug overdose on the corner of 5th and Main. I don't know if he's breathing. I don't know how many people are involved. I'm a passerby.
notes: Edge case: unknown victim count. System should not apply victim count multiplier but should still score high from overdose + possible unconscious indicators. Expect P0.

transcript: My partner hit me. I got away but I don't know where I am. I'm near a gas station somewhere on the east side. Please help me.
notes: Edge case: domestic violence with no address. Active violence indicator should produce P1. Low location score applies penalty but should not drop below P1 given the violence indicators.

transcript: Someone is acting erratic and making threats near the bus stop at Main and 3rd. I think he might have had a gun in his jacket — I couldn't clearly see it. He's gone now, ran northbound.
notes: Edge case: hedged weapon phrasing ('I think he might have had a gun'). The current parser extracts weapon_present from 'gun' regardless of the hedge — the negation filter handles hard negation ('no gun') but not uncertainty markers ('might have', 'I think'). Expected P2 documents this known behavior. A future improvement could downweight uncertain indicator language.

transcript: Sorry to call, false alarm — I thought I heard gunshots in the alley but my neighbor says it was just a car backfiring. Nobody seems to be hurt and I don't see anything wrong. Disregard, everything is fine.
notes: Known gap: false alarm retraction. The caller explicitly retracts ('false alarm', 'disregard', 'everything is fine') but 'gunshots' still triggers weapon_present extraction, producing a higher score than P4. This fixture is EXPECTED TO FAIL under the current parser — it documents the gap in false-alarm suppression. Resolving it requires adding 'false alarm' and 'disregard' to the POSSIBLE_PRANK keyword set or implementing retraction-aware parsing.

transcript: There's been a multi-car crash on Route 9 near the old overpass. One driver is on the ground — completely unresponsive and not breathing. There is a lot of blood everywhere. I cannot see a street number, just Route 9.
notes: Edge case: partial address (highway reference, no number) with multiple critical indicators (not_breathing, victim_unconscious, active_bleeding). LOW_LOCATION_CONFIDENCE penalty fires but three life-threat indicators overwhelm it. Tests that route/landmark references without street numbers still score critical incidents correctly.
